page.notes: Marginal note "Philosophiæ utilitas & necessitas in disputationibus Theologicis" is set in several short lines at the right margin, beside "ipsam". Greek passages are transcribed from a small, slightly blurred scan; the Greek in the line "ὅπου παιδείας ἐπι-στήμης" and the accents in "δυνα-τὸς" are doubtful and should be checked against the original. The ending "conjunxe-" is a line-end hyphen; the rest of the word is on the next page. Italic boundaries inside the Schegkii sentence are approximate.
